text: aria: Quick design question — in the trace drilldown, should the trace metadata (correlation ID, status, duration) live inline next to action buttons, or in a separate header area? Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx sam: My gut is inline for compact views, header for wide. Inline is faster to scan when you're triaging. devon: +1 to inline for mobile and narrow panes. But we need to make the export / copy actions super discoverable — maybe a visible `Copy ID` and an overflow kebab for less-common actions. jess: Accessibility: inline reduces distance between info and actions which is good, but be careful about keyboard focus order. `Copy correlation ID` must have an explicit aria-label and visible focus style. Toast should be announced to SRs. aria: Proposing three variants to prototype: 1) full header (meta stacked above actions), 2) compact inline (meta left, actions right, kebab), 3) floating CTA for export (sticky at bottom). Which should we build first? sam: Prototype 2 (compact inline) and 3 (floating CTA) — 2 for quick triage flows, 3 for bulk/export workflows. Also note: copy action must be local-only (no network) and should read from DOM `data-attr` to avoid latency. devon: We'll need success metrics: reduce clicks to export, reduce support tickets asking \"where's the ID\". Instrument events: `trace_export_click`, `trace_copy_corrid`, `trace_kebab_open`. aria: Copy text: currently \"Copy correlation ID\" vs shorter \"Copy ID\". jess — what's better for SRs? jess: Use full \"Copy correlation ID\" for clarity. Short labels are fine visually, but aria-label should be full phrase when the visible text is short. Also use role=\"status\" with `aria-live=polite` for the toast that says \"Correlation ID copied\" so screen readers announce it. sam: Keyboard nav notes: tab to focus actions, Enter to open menu, ArrowDown/ArrowUp to navigate menu items. Add `aria-haspopup=\"true\"` and `aria-controls` for the menu. Ensure focus returns to the trigger after action. devon: Small implementation snippet for copy button we'd recommend to eng: aria: Nice. UX question: do we show the corr id inline as plain text (selectable) or as a truncated pill with hover-to-copy? Thoughts? sam: Show full selectable text on desktop; pill/truncation on very small screens with a tap-to-expand. That handles copy & selection edge cases. jess: If we truncate visually, still expose full value to SRs via `aria-label` on the pill. Also ensure copy fallback for keyboard users (select-all + copy). aria: Decisions so far: compact inline first; `Copy correlation ID` visible; kebab for secondary actions; ARIA labels and polite toast; keyboard nav per sam. devon: Action items: 1) aria — update Figma with inline + floating CTA variants and add copy microcopy, due Tue 9AM. 2) sam — prototype keyboard navigation + a11y behavior in a small PR, due Wed. 3) dev — analytics spec for `trace_export_click` and `trace_copy_corrid`, include event props (trace_id, user_tier, mode), due Thu. design-bot: Added tasks to board: UX-1423 (Inline trace meta prototype), UX-1424 (Floating export CTA), UX-1425 (A11y + keyboard PR) :thumbsup: aria: Thanks team — I'll post the Figma update and prototype links once ready. sam: Sounds good. If anyone's blocked by copy, ping me. jess: I'll draft the SR announcement pattern for the toast and paste it into the PR. aria: Closing thread for now, will reopen with updated mocks. Thanks!
